title: Mud ring / Monstrous Mudwalker
summary: Break apart the Sludge Lurker repeatedly, then defeat the Filth Gorgers and Monstrous Mudwalker.
overview: Break apart the Sludge Lurker repeatedly, then defeat the Filth Gorgers and Monstrous Mudwalker.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Clear the required mudwalkers and seekers to summon the Sludge Lurker.
Across four successive stages, the lurker breaks into ten muck mudlets at 75%, 60%, 40% and 15%. Kill every mudlet to reform the lurker and continue.
Finish the lurker sequence and the four Filth Gorgers to summon the Monstrous Mudwalker, or the cooldown replacement.
The final boss can clear hate, and killing a player or pet creates additional mudlets. Minimize casualties while keeping an add tank available.
Complete the ring within three hours and the final boss within its fifty-minute appearance window.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
